items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Louie Morgan used to be the barroom there. Louie Morgan, he was the captain. Yeah. Morgan, he was the captain on the police force.

ctx.x: They tell me there'd be a dozen bands over there waiting to get out on the lake sometimes.

That's right. They'd all be sitting right there waiting. Standing right there. Louie Morgan used to be the barroom there. Louie Morgan, he was the captain. Yeah. Morgan, he was the captain on the police force.
It was the barroom out of the lake.
